outcome: themes derived from postnatal interview transcripts
cohort: Women who were 1 year postnatal, aged >=18 years, had an uncomplicated singleton pregnancy, and an antenatal booking BMI >= 30 kg/m2.
finding: Women reported making specific changes to their eating and physical activity behaviours, and identified six behaviour change techniques (BCTs) as helpful, with Self-monitoring of behaviour, Prompts/cues, and Social support being the most frequently reported.
